description: In a busy family kitchen on a warm evening, seen through an open doorway, a laughing young woman in a cream cable-knit jumper is greeted by a big golden retriever standing up on its back legs with its paws on her, while another young woman hugs her from the side. A young man rushes over and hugs her too, and they all laugh together. An older man holds up a cake, a second dog stands in front, and bunting hangs over the stove and dresser.
